expected_claims.statement: The effective travel-planning system can create or update Google Sheets through source-bound export tooling.
qualifications: Google provider destination is fixed/provider-managed, not arbitrary egress.
evidence: agent.py: root/financial workflow exposes export tooling

expected_claims.statement: The effective travel-planning system can create Google Docs through source-bound export tooling.
evidence: agent.py: export_to_google_doc_tool is exposed to root workflow

expected_claims.statement: The root agent can invoke a destructive Google Drive file-delete operation.
qualifications: Deletion is scoped by a supplied Drive file ID; destination is Google Drive, not arbitrary network.
evidence: agent.py: delete_google_file_tool is source-bound and described as permanent

expected_claims.statement: State-changing Google export/delete tooling is source-bound without a detected per-call human approval boundary in the reviewed source.
qualifications: This is about approval/control, not destination breadth.
evidence: agent.py/tools.py: bound mutation tools; no source-visible approval callback around these calls

expected_paths.statement: User-controlled request can reach the root agent and a source-bound Drive deletion tool.
qualifications: Concrete deletion still requires a file ID selected/provided through the tool call.

expected_paths.statement: User-controlled request can lead the agent workflow to create provider-hosted documents/spreadsheets.

negative_controls.statement: google_search must not be represented as arbitrary caller-selected network destination authority.
evidence: agent.py binds ADK google_search hosted/provider tool

negative_controls.statement: Service-account credential file usage must not be reported as a literal committed credential unless literal credential material is actually present.
Google provider APIs must not be described as unrestricted Internet egress.

coverage_notes: The source pack establishes provider export/delete operations and delegation; live IAM effectiveness is not verified.
